mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNT_TBL (a_id, c_no, a_account_no, a_app_id, a_product_code, a_account_type, a_opened_at, a_account_pwd, a_closed_at, a_status, a_balance, a_currency, a_nickname, a_last_tx_at, a_created_by, a_updated_at, a_agree_terms, a_agree_privacy, a_agree_marketing, a_rate) VALUES (#{aId}, #{cNo}, #{accountNo}, #{appId}, #{productCode}, #{accountType}, #{openedAt}, #{accountPwd}, #{closedAt}, #{status}, #{balance}, #{currency}, #{nickname}, #{lastTxAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{agreeTerms}, #{agreePrivacy}, #{agreeMarketing}, #{rate})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ACCOUNT_TBL WHERE a_id = #{aId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ACCOUNT_TBL WHERE a_account_no = #{accountNo})
